evals.prompt: Use $review-me on my plan to add team invitations. The repository already shows our roles and email provider.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the repository for existing facts, builds a dependency-ordered decision frontier, and asks one remaining product decision with a recommendation.
assertions: Repository facts such as existing roles and provider contracts are inspected rather than asked back to the user.
Exactly one decision question is active at a time.
The question provides a specific recommended answer and tradeoff.

evals.prompt: Review this upload design. It should be fast, simple, and recover automatically when something goes wrong.
evals.expected_output: Turns each fuzzy quality and recovery promise into measurable child decisions and follows their consequences to closed leaves.
assertions: Fuzzy qualities create measurable child decisions instead of being accepted as complete.
Failure, retry, partial progress, and recovery ownership are traversed as consequential branches.
Each leaf ends with an observable acceptance example.

evals.prompt: Use /review-me for our billing migration. Halfway through I change the rollout from all-at-once to tenant-by-tenant.
evals.expected_output: Reopens rollout-dependent descendants, resolves the new per-tenant failure and compatibility branches, and does not preserve stale leaf conclusions.
assertions: A changed ancestor decision reopens every descendant whose assumptions changed.
The next question follows dependency order and asks only one decision.
Completion waits for rollout, mixed-version, recovery, and proof lenses to be accounted for.

evals.prompt: We have answered the happy-path questions for a public export link. Wrap up the review now.
evals.expected_output: Audits every lens, resumes questioning for unresolved authorization, expiry, abuse, failure, and revocation branches, then requests final confirmation only after leaf closure.
assertions: An empty-looking frontier is audited against every review lens before completion.
The review is labeled incomplete while consequential nodes remain open.
Final completion requires the user's confirmation of the closure record.
